{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the correct column for disease severity
severity_col = [col for col in data.columns if 'severity' in col.lower()][0]

# Check the unique values in the severity column
severity_values = data[severity_col].unique()
print(f'Severity column: {severity_col}')
print(f'Unique values: {severity_values}')

# Check the biomarker column
biomarker_col = 'biomarker_baseline'

# Check for sentinel values or missing data in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Baseline biomarker column: {biomarker_col}')
print(f'Unique values in biomarker_baseline: {data[biomarker_col].unique()}')

# Check for -999.0 as a sentinel value
sentinel_value = -999.0
print(f'Sentinel value {sentinel_value} appears in biomarker_baseline: {data[biomarker_col].isin([sentinel_value]).any()}')

# Filter data for patients with SEVERE disease
severe_data = data[data[severity_col] == 'severe']

# Check if there are any SEVERE patients
print(f'Number of SEVERE patients: {len(severe_data)}')

# Calculate mean baseline biomarker value for SEVERE patients, excluding sentinel values
mean_biomarker_severe = severe_data[biomarker_col].replace(sentinel_value, pd.NA).mean()

# Print the result
mean_biomarker_severe"}
